1	import unittest
2	from api import update_preferences
3	from settings import patch_settings
4	
5	
6	class SettingsTests(unittest.TestCase):
7	    def test_updates_note(self):
8	        original = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
9	        result = update_preferences(original, {"note": "after"})
10	        self.assertEqual(result, {"note": "after", "enabled": True})
11	        self.assertEqual(original["note"], "before")
12	
13	
14	class PatchSettingsTests(unittest.TestCase):
15	    def test_omitted_keys_keep_current_values(self):
16	        current = {"note": "keep", "enabled": True}
17	        result = patch_settings(current, {"enabled": False})
18	        self.assertEqual(result, {"note": "keep", "enabled": False})
19	
20	    def test_falsey_values_replace_current(self):
21	        current = {"note": "before", "count": 5, "enabled": True, "label": "x"}
22	        for key, value in (
23	            ("note", None),
24	            ("label", ""),
25	            ("enabled", False),
26	            ("count", 0),
27	        ):
28	            with self.subTest(key=key, value=value):
29	                result = patch_settings(current, {key: value})
30	                self.assertEqual(result[key], value)
31	
32	    def test_adds_new_key(self):
33	        result = patch_settings({"a": 1}, {"b": 2})
34	        self.assertEqual(result, {"a": 1, "b": 2})
35	
36	    def test_does_not_mutate_caller_inputs(self):
37	        current = {"note": "before"}
38	        patch = {"note": None}
39	        patch_settings(current, patch)
40	        self.assertEqual(current, {"note": "before"})
41	        self.assertEqual(patch, {"note": None})
